# LaSabroso — Full Site Reference

> Hybrid-boho café in Madhapur, Hyderabad. Handcrafted coffee, signature momos, wood-fired pizzas, live dessert lab. Open daily 11:00–23:00.

## Profile

LaSabroso is a boho café tucked into Madhapur — a hybrid of specialty coffee bar, momo kitchen, wood-fired pizza counter and dessert lab. Known for the chocolate khoma dessert, signature veg steam momos, hand-tossed wood-fired pizzas and single-origin pour-overs. The courtyard is fairy-lit outdoor seating, popular for evenings, open-mic nights and pet-friendly visits. Parking: two- and four-wheeler parking in the lane outside; paid parking on Madhapur main road within a 2-minute walk.

## Menu (121 dishes / 20 categories)

Menu highlights include chocolate khoma, veg steam momos, creamy garlic prawns, wood-fired pizzas, cold brew coffee, and a live dessert lab with nitro and rolled ice cream. The full searchable menu with prices lives on the site: https://lasabroso.srishanth.com/#menu

## Events & Hosting

- Corporate & bulk orders: catering for offices and team offsites across HITEC City, up to 35% off on bulk
- Birthdays & private dinners: courtyard reservations with custom dessert lab counters
- Open mic & live acoustic: weekend evenings, no cover charge
- Couples night (Thursday): complimentary dessert offer

## Reservations & Contact

- Reservations: DM @lasabroso_cafe on Instagram with name, date, guest count and preferred time; confirmed within minutes during open hours
- Payment: all major UPI apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), credit/debit cards, cash
- Dine-in deals: Zomato District and Swiggy Dineout flat 10–35% off

## FAQs

Q: Do you take reservations?
A: Yes. DM us on Instagram (@lasabroso_cafe) with your name, date, guest count and preferred time. We confirm within minutes during open hours and hold your table for 15 minutes past the booking.

Q: Is parking available?
A: Yes. Two-wheeler and four-wheeler parking is available in the lane right outside the café. For larger groups, the Madhapur main road has ample paid parking within a 2-minute walk.

Q: Is the café pet-friendly?
A: Well-behaved, leashed pets are welcome in the outdoor courtyard seating. We keep a water bowl ready. Indoor seating is reserved for humans to keep the dessert lab counter hygienic.

Q: Do you have free Wi-Fi?
A: Yes. Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi for all guests. Ask the counter for the current password. Power outlets are available at most window seats, ideal for remote work over a cold brew.

Q: Can you host private events or bulk orders?
A: Absolutely. We cater corporate offsites, birthdays and team dinners for 20 to 60 guests, with up to 35% off on bulk. Custom menus, live counters and a dessert lab setup are all available.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: All major UPI apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), credit and debit cards, and cash. Dine-in deals from Zomato District and Swiggy Dineout give flat 10 to 35% off your bill.
